title: 番茄奶油雞蝦義大利麵

issues.description: Defined a complete one-serving tomato-cream sauce and aligned chicken and shrimp amounts with separate doneness endpoints (74°C poultry; 63°C shrimp). Text review covered all four locale bodies. Recipe timing, yield, and sensory outcome remain unverified because no kitchen trial was performed; no trial evidence or restaurant provenance is claimed.
issues.suggested_fix: Have a cook prepare the recipe as written, record actual prep and cook time and yield, confirm texture and applicable safe internal temperatures, then update the article before reconsidering indexing.
